opening.argument: The description promotes a “passive income opportunity,” while the narration gives members a concrete path to commit Bitcoin to the program: “how to move your money from your Activation Wallet to your Trading Pool.” It then directs users to “go into a into the pool account and add funds to pool that's on the left hand side.” The displayed form confirms that this is a transfer of funds, identifying the Activation Wallet as the payment source and providing a submission control. The success message then confirms that the funds were sent to the pool account. These are not merely general promotional claims; they show the operational step by which existing members were directed to place funds into MTI’s Trading Pool in pursuit of the advertised passive-income opportunity.
